title: Create Langfuse datasets for EDD scenarios
description: Create or update Langfuse datasets and dataset items for EDD scenarios when local Langfuse credentials and explicit dataset sync are enabled, while keeping deterministic planned refs in CI and mock mode.
acceptance_criteria: Scenario creation keeps planned Langfuse dataset refs by default; when EDD_PLATFORM_LANGFUSE_DATASET_SYNC=live and Langfuse env vars are configured, scenario creation calls Langfuse create_dataset/create_dataset_item and stores live dataset/dataset_item refs with useful metadata; API tests cover default planned refs and mocked live sync without network credentials.
close_reason: Implemented opt-in live Langfuse scenario dataset sync with deterministic planned refs by default. Verified with uv run pytest tests/test_agent_designs.py -k 'scenario_and_eval_contract_artifacts or live_syncs_langfuse_dataset_refs' and ./scripts/test.sh.

title: Model Langfuse trace dataset and score refs in platform artifacts
description: Make Langfuse ids first-class references on platform evidence so UI and context packs can bridge to traces, datasets, prompts, and scores.
acceptance_criteria: Artifacts expose typed Langfuse references for traces, datasets, dataset items, prompts, and scores; the UI renders clear links instead of opaque ids; context packs include these references when relevant.
close_reason: Added typed external_refs to artifacts and populated Langfuse trace refs for manual, scratch, and project runs.

title: Map EDD scenarios to Langfuse datasets
description: Represent platform scenarios and eval cases as Langfuse datasets/items so suites can be reused, versioned, and inspected in Langfuse.
acceptance_criteria: Creating or updating an EDD scenario can create or link a Langfuse dataset item; platform artifacts store the Langfuse dataset and item ids; CI remains deterministic without Langfuse credentials.
close_reason: Scenario artifacts now carry deterministic Langfuse dataset and dataset_item external refs for platform-side mapping without live credentials.

title: Write eval outcomes as Langfuse scores
description: Persist deterministic and LLM-as-judge eval results to Langfuse scores while retaining platform eval artifacts and decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Each live run/eval can write score records to Langfuse; platform EvalResult/JudgeOutput artifacts store Langfuse score ids; local tests skip or mock score writes without credentials.
close_reason: Implemented opt-in Langfuse score sync for live run evaluations. EvalResult and JudgeOutput artifacts now receive typed score refs when EDD_PLATFORM_LANGFUSE_SCORE_SYNC=live and Langfuse credentials plus a trace ref are available. Verified with focused API tests and ./scripts/test.sh.

title: Move agent and judge prompts into Langfuse prompt management
description: Externalize agent prompts and judge prompt templates into Langfuse prompt management while keeping platform versions linked to prompt ids and labels.
acceptance_criteria: Agent and judge prompt records can reference Langfuse prompt name/version/label; live runs record prompt links on traces; mock/CI paths do not require Langfuse.
close_reason: Added Langfuse prompt identity fields for agent designs, agent versions, and judge prompt templates; stored typed prompt external refs on platform artifacts; live run and trace evidence now record active prompt refs without requiring Langfuse in mock/CI. Verified with focused API tests, regenerated OpenAPI, and ./scripts/test.sh.

title: Langfuse-backed eval data plane
description: Use Langfuse as the eval/observability data plane for prompts, datasets, traces, scores, and experiment evidence while EDD Platform remains the workflow and decision control plane.

title: Split tool calls and results into evidence artifacts
description: Promote tool calls and tool results from embedded run metadata into inspectable, linked evidence artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: A live or mock run shows which tools were requested, what inputs were used, what outputs returned, and how those artifacts support eval decisions.
close_reason: Done: tool calls and tool results are now first-class artifacts linked to run evidence; verified with API tests and web build.

title: Make eval contracts fully data-driven
description: Replace remaining hardcoded proof checks with scenario-specific EvalContract data that describes required evidence, tool expectations, output shape, forbidden behavior, and pass/fail criteria.
acceptance_criteria: A new agent behavior can be evaluated by editing contract data rather than adding a code branch.
close_reason: Done: EvalContract fields now generate deterministic checks for required evidence, required/forbidden tools, forbidden behavior, and output requirements; evaluation reads all run evidence artifacts. Verified with API tests and web build.

title: Model agent versions beyond v0 and v1
description: Represent candidate versions as first-class platform records so the loop can continue through v2, v3, and later improvements without fixed UI assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: The UI and API can create, run, evaluate, and compare more than one candidate version for the same agent design.
close_reason: Implemented reusable current-to-next version loop and verified v0/v1/v2 API labeling.

title: Prove eval-driven design for arbitrary agents
description: Build the end-to-end platform loop where a user defines an agent, defines expectations, runs baseline behavior, evaluates evidence, applies bounded fixes when needed, and compares candidate versions.
acceptance_criteria: A reviewer can create an arbitrary agent, define a scenario and eval contract, run live or mock behavior, inspect evidence artifacts and traces, and see whether a candidate improved.

title: Show pass state as evidence-backed lifecycle completion
description: When a generated agent passes its contract, show the specific evidence that proves it: agent version, tool used, run result, judge result, and trace link when available.
acceptance_criteria: A passing generated lifecycle does not only show Complete; it summarizes passed contract evidence, tool calls, run evidence, judge evidence, and available trace links with inspectable artifacts.

title: Clarify live run and judge modes in proof loop
description: Make run mode and judge mode explicit in the proof loop, especially the distinction between live agent execution, deterministic checks, and live rubric judging.
acceptance_criteria: Proof loop shows current run mode and judge mode near the active action; deterministic rubric-only failures are explained as needing live judge scoring; users can intentionally run live judge for rubric contracts.
notes: Starting live run/judge clarity slice. Goal: show run mode and judge mode near the active proof action and explain deterministic rubric-only failures.
close_reason: Proof loop now shows run mode and judge mode near the active action and explains deterministic rubric-only failures as needing live rubric judging. Verified with npm run web:build.

title: Guide users through running the generated lifecycle
description: Replace the generic proof-loop empty/start state for outcome-created agents with a generated-test flow that starts from the already-created scenario and eval contract.
acceptance_criteria: For outcome-created agents, the proof loop says the generated v0 test is ready; the primary action runs the current version; users are not prompted to manually create a test before running the generated scenario and contract.
notes: Starting generated lifecycle run guidance. Goal: when an outcome-created agent has a generated scenario/contract, the Proof loop should lead with running v0, not creating/selecting a test.
close_reason: Updated the Proof loop for outcome-created agents to show a generated lifecycle, generated test labeling, Run v0 as the primary action, Evaluate as the next action, and no New test prompt before running the generated scenario/contract. Verified with npm run web:build.

title: Surface auto-created tool lifecycle in the console
description: Make generated and promoted tools visible in the agent workspace so users can see when the platform created an approved executable capability and enabled it for the generated agent.
acceptance_criteria: Agent workspace shows generated tool status such as auto-created, approved, and enabled; F1 schedule/result outcome agents display lookup_event_schedule or lookup_event_result as enabled; draft tools remain distinguishable when present.
notes: Starting tool lifecycle visibility slice. Goal: make generated/approved/enabled tool status visible for outcome-created agents without changing API shape.
close_reason: Implemented generated tool lifecycle visibility in the Agent tab and generated design review. Outcome-created tools now show auto-created, status, implementation kind, and enabled/not enabled state. Verified with npm run web:build.

title: Show generated design review after outcome draft
description: After drafting from outcome, show the generated agent, scenario, eval contract, required tools, auto-created tools, and allowed tools as a reviewable design summary before the user runs the proof loop.
acceptance_criteria: Outcome-created agents land on a generated design review; the review identifies the generated scenario, contract, required tools, auto-created tools, and enabled tools; each persisted object has an inspectable evidence path.
notes: Starting generated design review slice. Goal: after outcome drafting, land users on an inspectable summary of generated agent, scenario, contract, and tools before they run the proof loop.
close_reason: Implemented generated design review in the Proof loop. Outcome-created agents now show generated version, scenario, contract, required tools, auto-created/enabled tools, draft tools, and output requirements, with inspect actions for available artifacts. Verified with npm run web:build.

title: Make outcome drafting the primary agent creation flow
description: Reshape the empty-state agent creation screen around a single desired outcome input. Keep manual creation available as a secondary path, but stop requiring users to name the agent before the platform drafts the first design.
acceptance_criteria: A user can start from an outcome only; the primary CTA drafts an agent from outcome; manual creation remains available but secondary; copy aligns with outcome-first workflow.
notes: Starting with the empty-state creation screen so the frontend entrypoint matches the outcome-first E2E lifecycle.
close_reason: Implemented outcome-only primary creation flow in the console. Manual creation is now a secondary expandable path. Verified with npm run web:build; direct browser inspection was blocked because Playwright browsers are not installed and Codex app inspection is disallowed.

title: Mirror EDD review notes to Langfuse comments
description: Add an optional path for EDD human review notes or trace diagnoses to create Langfuse comments on linked traces/prompts while keeping platform artifacts as the source of truth. Treat Langfuse annotation queues as a separate later workflow for structured human eval queues.
acceptance_criteria: Platform can store a review/comment artifact linked to a run, eval, trace, or prompt; when explicit Langfuse comment sync is enabled and credentials are configured, the API creates a Langfuse comment on the linked trace or prompt and stores a typed external ref back on the platform artifact; default local/CI behavior remains deterministic without Langfuse credentials; docs explain comments vs annotation queues.
close_reason: Added platform ReviewNote API and REVIEW_NOTE artifacts linked to target evidence; optional EDD_PLATFORM_LANGFUSE_COMMENT_SYNC=live mirrors notes to Langfuse comments on trace/prompt refs and stores typed comment external refs. Docs distinguish comments from annotation queues. Verified with focused review-note tests, regenerated OpenAPI, and ./scripts/test.sh.

title: Surface Langfuse evidence in UI and context packs
description: Update the platform UI and context pack assembly so Langfuse-backed datasets, prompts, traces, and scores are visible and useful during EDD decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence cards show meaningful Langfuse links for trace, dataset, prompt, and score refs; context packs include Langfuse refs with labels/relevance; no raw opaque ids are shown without explanatory labels.

title: Refactor API main module into focused modules
description: Split apps/api/edd_platform_api/main.py into route, model, service, storage, and app wiring modules without changing public API behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Existing API tests and OpenAPI contract tests pass with main.py no longer holding all route, model, and service code.

title: Finish schema-first tool registry adapters
description: Extend user-created tool definitions from draft/approval/mock execution into adapter contracts for LangChain/LangGraph, OpenAI tool calling, MCP, OpenAPI docs, and eval validation.
acceptance_criteria: Approved user tools define input/output schema and can be adapted consistently by the runner and contract evaluator.

title: Populate dedicated public docs repo
description: Use bfalkowski/edd-platform-docs as the public documentation site for concepts, guides, API references, architecture notes, local demo walkthroughs, and product narratives.
acceptance_criteria: The docs repo is linked from this repo and has an initial migration/population checklist for the product docs it should own.
